differencing_justification: ADF unit-root test p-value < 0.0001 proves training RTT series is strongly stationary in levels; differencing d=1 is unneeded over-differencing. Autoregressive AR(1) captures short-term persistence without artificial integration.
objective_alignment: Log-transformation ln(RTT) maps the L2/Gaussian error minimization under exponentiation to the conditional geometric mean/median (~50 ms), eliminating the severe ~50 ms baseline penalty incurred by fitting in levels.
